premises.text: BridgeFi allows apps to work offline by integrating an SDK

premises.text: BridgeFi creates mesh networks to extend communication range
premises.evidence_span: it creates mesh networks, which means that information can hop on devices found in the middle

premises.text: BridgeFi is the only solution with Android to iOS integration
premises.evidence_span: We are the only ones in the market with Android to iOS integration

premises.text: BridgeFi can be used in emergencies to connect people without internet
premises.evidence_span: being able to connect with rescue corps or being able to connect with their teachers

premises.text: Developers can monetize through monthly active users using BridgeFi
premises.evidence_span: We charge based on monthly active users that use your app, thanks to our technology
